changes: Implemented read-only lifecycle_check with StoryReadinessReport output, exact blocker next actions, review/DONE readiness rows, process-fact L0 registration, and focused lifecycle smoke coverage.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js lifecycle_check --storyId=B-bd45 --target=DONE or lattice lifecycle_check --storyId=B-xxxx --target=REVIEW|TEST|DONE.
expectedOutcome: A host can run one read-only readiness check and see the current lifecycle blockers, owners, and next commands without mutating evidence or claiming Authority completion.
actualTranscript: Real-machine transcript recorded in .lattice/story/actives/B-bd45/evidence/transcript-diff.md: lifecycle_check reported read-only mode and exact blockers; validate passed 17 configured commands with 9/9 coverage; done_required_validate passed; Round 3 reviewers and full-3x2 escalation passed.
outcomeDiff: No difference from expected. V1 remains read-only and reports Authority as external wait only.
limitations: V1 intentionally does not run commands, write evidence, launch reviewers, advance phases, run done_prepare, or verify Authority/production receipts.
pitfalls: DONE-required validation initially failed because process-fact contract still scanned legacy cli-engine MAIN_TOOLS instead of command-catalog; fixed by registering lifecycle_check as L0 and updating the contract scanner.
